versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "find-web-developer" skill for discovering and shortlisting US-based web development firms.
- Supports filtering firms by platform (e.g., Webflow, WordPress, Shopify), location, vertical, and other website-related needs.
- Automatically defers to dedicated skills for custom software, broader marketing, or SEO-only work.
- Integrates with the ServiceGraph API, leveraging a large catalog of US web development firms.
- Provides example API usage patterns, authentication instructions, and filter guidelines for various web project scenarios.
